scripts: {{names}} is a list of quoted request or folder names. This and the next messages are shown after importing a collection.
andMore: {{names}} is a list of quoted names; {{count}} is the number of names that are not shown.
place: Where a script note applies. Used as {{label}} in the script messages, for example: Postman request "Login", pre-request script, line 3: ...
stage: The script that a note applies to. Used as {{stage}} in the script messages.
script: Notes about scripts translated from another tool. {{tool}} is the name of that tool, {{api}} the name of its script object, for example pm.*.
script.line: {{label}} and {{stage}} are short phrases, {{note}} is one of the script messages.
script.rewritten: A use is one place where a script calls the other tool's API.
script.checks: Assertions are rows of Bruno's assert block.
skip: Items that were not imported at all.
skip.fileError: {{detail}} is the technical reason from the file parser, in English.
grpcScripts: One message for each place the scripts belong to: a collection, a folder or a request. {{kinds}} is a comma separated list of script names such as onmessage, onerror. {{name}} is the name of the collection, folder or request.
gostmanItem: One message for each kind of item in a Gostman export that could not be read. Each is a complete sentence about one item (or, for settings, about the settings as a whole).
unresolved: About a WSDL file that points to other files that were not part of the import. {{files}} is a list of file names.
postmanLegacy: About a collection in the old Postman v1 format. The named form quotes the collection name; the numbered form is used when the collection has no name, and {{number}} is its position in the file.
externalSecrets: {{names}} is a list of variable names with the place they read from in brackets.
httpProcessEnv: {{example}} is the literal text of a variable placeholder, with double braces.
dotEnv: {{example}} is the literal text of a variable placeholder, with double braces. process.env.NAME is a variable name and stays as written.
liquidFilters: {{example}} is the literal text of a template expression with a filter, with double braces.
fileTags: {{example}} is the literal text of a file function, with double braces.
authType: {{type}} is the name of the authentication type in the other tool, for example digest.
documentRead: {{detail}} is the technical reason from the file parser, in English.
